REALTIME PRESENCE PLATFORM / 2026

Orbit — Realtime Presence & Spatial Collaboration Network

A realtime spatial communication platform focused on live presence, collaboration, immersive mapping, and cinematic interaction systems.

  • Realtime location tracking with MapLibre GL
  • Live communication using Socket.IO & WebSockets
  • Interactive Three.js landing experience
  • Private rooms with secure passcode access

COMPUTER VISION SYSTEM / 2025

Sentinel — Realtime Vehicle & ALPR System

A desktop-based computer vision application built with Python, OpenCV, YOLOv8, and OCR for real-time vehicle and license plate detection. The system captures live camera feeds, extracts plate information, stores detection history in SQLite, and provides an interactive monitoring dashboard through a custom PyQt6 interface.

  • Real-time vehicle detection using YOLOv8
  • Automatic license plate localization and OCR
  • Multi-threaded processing for smooth performance
  • Detection history with image and timestamp storage
  • SQLite-powered record management system
  • Modern PyQt6 desktop interface
FULL STACK WEB APPLICATION / 2024

Jewellery Store Management System

A full-stack jewellery e-commerce platform designed for product management, customer authentication, shopping cart operations, and administrative control through a PHP and MySQL backend architecture.

  • Full-stack e-commerce platform powered by PHP & MySQL
  • Secure customer login, registration & session management
  • Dynamic product catalog and inventory administration
  • Shopping cart workflow with real-time item management
  • Category-based product organization and navigation
  • MySQL database integration for persistent data storage
  • Responsive Bootstrap frontend optimized for multiple devices
  • Built using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript & Bootstrap
